affected_predicate.description: Provide an integer total for the three most expensive items in the TaoDian shopping cart.

competing_trace_defects.description: After the cart was visibly empty, the trajectory repeatedly alternated between the home and cart tabs rather than obtaining cart-item prices or producing the requested total.

chains.rationale: At the reuse target, the agent typed 930961 into the SMS verification-code field. The last observable screen still shows that login form with the code entered; it does not show a cart total or an integer task response. The reused action concerns login-code entry and has no visible bridge to the requested cart-total predicate.

summary: The sole reused history item was followed by SMS-code entry only; it has no visible relation to producing the requested cart total. A prior cart/home navigation loop is independently observable.
